name: application-command-menu-result-row
title: Command Menu Result Row
description: Reusable result-row primitive for command palettes, comboboxes, and search results: icon or avatar, title with meta text, and a trailing keyboard-shortcut hint or category badge.
useWhen: Rendering the individual result rows inside a Command Palette, combobox, or search dropdown.
You need a consistent row shape across mixed result types (actions, files, people) that differ only in icon and trailing hint.
The selected/highlighted row needs a distinct visual state for keyboard navigation.
avoidWhen: The row is a standalone settings or list item outside a listbox — use the generic Item component instead.
Results don't need an icon, meta line, or trailing hint — a plain text option is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Each row is a single flex line; title and meta text truncate with an ellipsis rather than wrapping so row height stays constant while scrolling results.
accessibility: Each row is role="option" with aria-selected reflecting keyboard-highlighted state, meant to sit inside a role="listbox" container.
Disabled rows carry aria-disabled and a real disabled button so they're skipped by keyboard interaction.
The trailing kbd hint uses the native <kbd> element; the category badge is plain text, not conveyed by color alone.

variants.title: Command Menu Result Row
variants.description: Four result rows in a listbox: a selected action with an Enter-key hint, a file result with a File badge, a person result with an avatar, and a disabled action explaining why.
accessibility: The selected row's aria-selected="true" should stay in sync with arrow-key navigation in a full implementation.

variants.title: Command Menu Result Row (Dark)
variants.description: The same four result rows adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-row background and icon contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
